proof_summary: Define the candidate linear-recurrence sequence \(c_{n+3}=4c_{n+2}-c_n\) and its defect \(E_n=c_{n+1}^2-c_{n+2}c_n\); algebraic induction gives \(E_{n+3}=4E_{n+1}+E_n\) and bounds \(1\le E_n\le c_n\). These bounds force \(\lceil c_{n+1}^2/c_n\rceil-1=c_{n+2}\), so induction identifies the original ceiling-defined sequence with \(c\), yielding the claimed recurrence and generating function.
